# tinyobjloader

`tiny_obj_loader.h` is the unmodified single-header tinyobjloader v2.0.0rc13.

Source: https://github.com/tinyobjloader/tinyobjloader/tree/v2.0.0rc13

MIT license and copyright notices are retained at the top of the header.
The implementation is compiled only in `src/scene/obj_loader.cpp`.
